zh: 我知道 我的救贖者活著 祂是永活的主
當我在深谷迷失時 祂領我走正義路
我知道 我的救贖者活著 祂是永活的主
當我在曠野孤獨時 祂伴我作我的燈
en: For I know Jesus lives forever more / my Savior and my King
When I’m lost in the deep valley / He leads me back to His way
For I know Jesus lives forever more / my Savior and my King
When I’m alone in wilderness / His light shines upon my path

zh: 我知道我的救贖者永遠活著
en: For I know my Redeemer lives forever
My heart will not forget
He fills my every day and night
with abundance of His life

zh: 我知道我的救贖者永遠活著
en: For I know my Redeemer lives forever
My heart will never fear
And on that day when the trumpet sounds
with my eyes, I will see His face
